# Copilot instructions

This repository is governed by **`AGENTS.md`** — read and follow it before making changes.

- **Specs:** specifications live in `docs/specs/<ID>-<slug>/`, indexed in `docs/specs/INDEX.md`.
  Read the index before starting a non-trivial feature and follow the `spec-driven-development` skill.
- **Rules:** `.agents/rules/` (e.g. `game-engine.md`, `ui-standards.md`, `code-standards.md`).
- **Skills:** `.agents/skills/`.
- **Context economy:** read `CODEMAP.md` before exploring; update `progress.md` before ending a session.

`AGENTS.md` and `.agents/` are the source of truth; do not duplicate their content here.
